<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://example.com/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentFailure" name="Payment failure notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BackorderDelay" name="Back-order delay notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingConfirmation" name="Shipping confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FeedbackEmail" name="Feedback email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryIssue" name="Customer delivery issue report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReturnLabel" name="Return shipping label"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="E-commerce company" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Place order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentFailure" name="Payment failure notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_PaymentFailure"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BackorderDelay" name="Back-order delay notification" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_BackorderDelay"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShippingConfirmation" name="Shipping confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FeedbackEmail" name="Feedback email" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryIssue" name="Report delivery issue" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveIssueReport" messageRef="Message_DeliveryIssue"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnLabel" name="Return shipping label" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ReturnLabel"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_OrderFulfillment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_OrderPlaced</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PaymentSuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyPaymentFailure</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_PaymentFailed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StockAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InitiateBackorder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InformDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_BackorderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmStockAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StockMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DispatchSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendShippingConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DispatchJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmDelivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendFeedbackEmail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_IssuesReported</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Fulfilled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouse">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_QualityControl</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PackagingSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PackageOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GiftRequested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiftWrap</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PackagingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Shipping" name="Shipping department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareShippingDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InternationalOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ShippingDocumentsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DispatchReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DispatchOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Dispatched</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Returns" name="Returns">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveIssueReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReturnLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveReturnedItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InspectReturnedItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundOrReplacement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessReplacement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReturnOutcomeMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ReturnsComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" name="Customer places order">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessPayment" name="Process payment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentSuccessful" name="Payment successful?" default="Flow_PaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" name="Notify customer of payment failure" messageRef="Message_PaymentFailure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PaymentFailed" name="Payment failed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock availability"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockAvailable" name="All required items in stock?" default="Flow_StockUnavailable"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InitiateBackorder" name="Initiate back-order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformDelay" name="Inform customer about delay" messageRef="Message_BackorderDelay"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BackorderReceived" name="Back-order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Backorder"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmStockAvailable" name="Confirm all required items are in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Stock paths merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick in-stock items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_QualityControl" name="Perform quality control checks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PackagingSplit" name="Prepare packaging and shipping documents" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageOrder" name="Package order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftRequested" name="Gift wrapping requested?" default="Flow_NoGiftWrap"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiftWrap" name="Gift wrap order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PackagingMerge" name="Packaging paths merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments" name="Prepare shipping documents and labels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalOrder" name="International order?" default="Flow_NotInternational"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments" name="Prepare customs documentation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShippingDocumentsMerge" name="Shipping documentation paths merge"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DispatchReady" name="Packaging and shipping documents ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DispatchOrder" name="Dispatch order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Dispatched" name="Order dispatched"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DispatchSplit" name="Shipping confirmation and inventory update" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" name="Send shipping confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_ShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DispatchJoin" name="Confirmation and inventory update complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm successful delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" name="Send follow-up email for feedback" messageRef="Message_FeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IssuesReported" name="Customer reports delivery issues?" default="Flow_NoIssues"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Fulfilled" name="Order fulfillment complete"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveIssueReport" name="Receive customer delivery issue report" messageRef="Message_DeliveryIssue"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReturnLabel" name="Send return shipping label" messageRef="Message_ReturnLabel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" name="Receive returned items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectReturnedItems" name="Inspect returned items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundOrReplacement" name="Refund or replacement?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process refund"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessReplacement" name="Process replacement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReturnOutcomeMerge" name="Return outcome merge"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReturnsComplete" name="Returns process complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Record" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Payment" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_ProcessPayment" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentSuccess" name="Successful" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentSuccessful" targetRef="Task_CheckStock">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>paymentSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentFailed" name="Failed" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentSuccessful" targetRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_FailedEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="EndEvent_PaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockAvailable" name="Available" sourceRef="Gateway_StockAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>allRequiredItemsInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockUnavailable" name="Out of stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockAvailable" targetRef="Task_InitiateBackorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_Inform" sourceRef="Task_InitiateBackorder" targetRef="Task_InformDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inform_BackorderReceived" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Event_BackorderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_ConfirmStock" sourceRef="Event_BackorderReceived" targetRef="Task_ConfirmStockAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmStock_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmStockAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockMerge_Pick" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pick_Quality" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_QualityControl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quality_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Task_QualityControl" targetRef="Gateway_PackagingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_Packaging" sourceRef="Gateway_PackagingSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_ShippingDocs" sourceRef="Gateway_PackagingSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Package_GiftDecision" sourceRef="Task_PackageOrder" targetRef="Gateway_GiftRequested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftRequested" name="Requested" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftRequested" targetRef="Task_GiftWrap">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>giftWrappingRequested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGiftWrap" name="Not requested" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftRequested" targetRef="Gateway_PackagingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrap_Merge" sourceRef="Task_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_PackagingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Packaging_DispatchReady" sourceRef="Gateway_PackagingMerge" targetRef="Gateway_DispatchReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingDocs_International" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International" name="International" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalOrder" targetRef="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>internationalOrder</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInternational" name="Not international" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalOrder" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingDocumentsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customs_ShippingMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingDocumentsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shipping_DispatchReady" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingDocumentsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_DispatchReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DispatchReady_Dispatch" sourceRef="Gateway_DispatchReady" targetRef="Task_DispatchOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dispatch_DispatchedEnd" sourceRef="Task_DispatchOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_Dispatched"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dispatch_ConfirmationInventory" sourceRef="Task_DispatchOrder" targetRef="Gateway_DispatchSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DispatchSplit_Confirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_DispatchSplit" targetRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DispatchSplit_Inventory" sourceRef="Gateway_DispatchSplit" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_DispatchJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_DispatchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inventory_DispatchJoin" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_DispatchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DispatchJoin_ConfirmDelivery" sourceRef="Gateway_DispatchJoin" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmDelivery_Feedback" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Issues" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="Gateway_IssuesReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssuesReported" name="Issues reported" sourceRef="Gateway_IssuesReported" targetRef="Task_ReceiveIssueReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>deliveryIssuesReported</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoIssues" name="No issues reported" sourceRef="Gateway_IssuesReported" targetRef="EndEvent_Fulfilled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Issue_ReturnLabel" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveIssueReport" targetRef="Task_SendReturnLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnLabel_ReceiveItems" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems" targetRef="Gateway_RefundOrReplacement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund" name="Refund" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundOrReplacement" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Replacement" name="Replacement" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundOrReplacement" targetRef="Task_ProcessReplacement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund_ReturnMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Gateway_ReturnOutcomeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Replacement_ReturnMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReplacement" targetRef="Gateway_ReturnOutcomeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnMerge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnOutcomeMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_ReturnsComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
